Welcome to Frontia — where everyone becomes the protagonist!
,
Community Rules
,
Be respectful — Harassment, hate speech, and any content that disrespects others are not allowed.
,
No spam, trolling, or misinformation — Content meant to deceive, exploit, or harm others is prohibited.
,
Respect privacy — Do not share others' personal information or impersonate members or staff.
,
No unrelated promotion — Personal advertising, solicitation, or unwanted DMs unrelated to Frontia are not allowed.
,
Interested in creating episodes?
,
Check the [Frontia Studio Guide] for everything about making episodes.

Need help?
,
Check the [Frontia Help Center] first — it's available in your language.
,
Found a bug or have an idea? Post it in ⁠액세스 권한 없음 or ⁠액세스 권한 없음  Write in your own language — we'll reply in it.
,
Want to change your language?
,
Open Channels & Roles at the top of the channel list (right under the server name), and update your answer to the language question anytime. You can select more than one language — your channels will switch right away.

Can't see any channels?
,
Pick your language under "Channels & Roles" at the top of the channel list to unlock the server. (수정됨)

Server rules
,
Five rules. They apply in every channel, including DMs started here.

1 · Treat people well
Criticise the work, never the person. No harassment, hate speech, slurs, or pile-ons. Don't bring fights from other servers here.

2 · Nothing sexual involving real people or minors
Fiction, roleplay, AI-generated images — no exceptions, no context makes it okay. This is a permanent ban on the first offence and is also Discord policy.

3 · Adult content belongs in ⁠🔞｜lounge-🚹
That channel is 19+ and age-confirmed on entry. Everything visible server-wide — your avatar, nickname, status, and anything posted outside that channel — stays safe for all ages, because those can't be age-gated.

4 · Talk about other platforms, don't recruit for them
Sharing what you learned elsewhere is welcome and useful. Advertising another service, or DMing members to move them, is not.

5 · No invite-code or link spam
Invite codes only work when someone creates a new account, and everyone here already has one. Posting a code gets it auto-removed.

Episode content ratings follow the Frontia Community Guide → https://community-guide.frontia.ai/
Something wrong? Right-click the message → Apps → Report, or DM a staff member. Staff decisions are final, and you can always ask us why. (수정됨)

Reading this server in your language
,
This server runs in 8 languages. You never have to switch. Write in yours — anyone can read it in theirs.


Any message → your language
,
1. Desktop: right-click the message · Phone: press and hold it
2. Open the apps menu that appears
3. Pick the one with the  globe — that's it

The globe looks the same in every language, so look for  rather than a word you don't recognise.
The translation shows up only for you and is never posted to the channel. It arrives in whatever language your Discord is set to, so nobody needs to tell you which language to pick.


마우스 오른쪽 클릭 / 길게 누르기 →  ・ 右クリック / 長押し →  ・ 按右鍵 / 長按 →  ・ clic derecho / mantener pulsado →  ・ clique direito / segurar →  ・ klik kanan / tahan →  ・ คลิกขวา / กดค้าง → 


Forum posts translate themselves
,
A post written in another language gets an English translation added right under it, automatically — once per post, so nothing gets noisy. To read it in your language instead, use the  on the post.

Post titles are not translated. A short English title helps people from other countries find your post.


Changing your own language
,
Tap the server name → Channels & Roles → pick again. Your lounge and news channel follow your choice. (수정됨)
